column1: #mapping_set_description: One genome entry of the refgenie-registry (genomes/<organism>/<name>.yaml), validated by schema/genome.schema.yaml. Each entry is one named sequence collection (one exact set of sequences, pinned by seqcol.digest) plus organism, assembly accession, FASTA download URLs, optional FHR provenance, and registry build instructions.
